name: catholicstoriesforchildren
description: You can run the code on osx using the Makefile. Simply type `make` in a terminal to start and `make stop` to stop.

scripts.watch:src: fswatch -or src build.js | xargs -n1 npm run build
scripts.preserve: bash -lc 'kill-port 8000 || true; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Killing PIDs on 8000: $pids"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 0.2; kill -KILL $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; i=0; while lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; do [ $i -ge 50 ] && break; sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done'
scripts.free:8000: bash -lc 'if command -v lsof >/dev/null; then pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Port 8000 is in use by $pids. Killing..."; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 0.2; kill -KILL $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; i=0; while lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; do if [ $i -ge 50 ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done; fi'
